log_level.description: Global logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

log_dir.description: Directory where log files are written

polling_interval.description: Time interval (in seconds) between polling instances for metrics

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle polling concurrently

ceilometer_endpoint.description: URL of the Ceilometer (telemetry) API endpoint

username.description: OpenStack service user name for authentication

password.description: Password for the service user (must be provided securely in production)

region_name.description: Optional OpenStack region name (leave empty to auto-detect or omit)

insecure.description: If true, disables SSL/TLS certificate verification (not recommended in production)

enabled_pollsters.description: List of pollster names to enable for instance metric collection

section.description: Config section name (typically the pollster name, e.g., 'instance')

interval.description: Override polling interval (in seconds) for this pollster (0 to use global interval)

pollster_configs.description: Optional per-pollster configuration overrides (e.g., custom intervals per metric type)

metric_url.description: Backend storage URL for collected metrics (e.g., MongoDB or SQLite URI)
